What to understand at MT13

Depth push
A run aimed at a higher Infinity number in a favorable region.
Coverage run
A run aimed at recording Infinity in another region. It does not have to be your deepest run to advance the regional objective.
Eternity Anvil
A military perk related to Anvil purchasing area. The supplied community route recommends considering it when the Anvil is a major investment.

What you are working toward

  • The supplied research describes Infinity 5 plus Infinity reached in ten different regions for MT14. Confirm those and the current module thresholds in Headquarters.
  • Maintain separate plans for deeper Infinity and broader map coverage.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an editorial synthesis of the supplied community research. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Keep a reliable baseline blueprint

    Start from the Infinity build that worked at MT12. When another region fails, inspect its enemies and copied effects before making wholesale changes. A targeted adjustment is easier to understand than replacing every module at once. [S09]

  2. Use the new travel-speed tools

    Research and inspect Wave Breach and Era Tunneling where available. The supplied research warns that Era Tunneling changed in v1.0, so follow the current tooltip rather than an old timing recipe. [S07] [S01]

  3. Complete region coverage methodically

    Choose a new region, reach the required Infinity record, and mark it complete. Favor manageable difficulties while satisfying the regional objective. Raising additional difficulties can support other systems, but it does not add another distinct region. [S02] [S09]

  4. Push depth where the build performs best

    Use your most reliable region to work toward Infinity 5. Compare failed attempts: inability to kill, copied defenses and inability to survive call for different module or Anvil changes. Use fragments to address the observed problem. [S09]

  5. Choose long-term support deliberately

    Consider Eternity Anvil if purchasing reach is limiting Anvil development, or compare other available perks such as Twin Singularity against your goals. Perk advice in community routes is a preference based on a strategy, not a mandatory promotion condition. [S05] [S12]

If you are stuck

One region keeps failing while others are easy

Inspect the regional elements and copied module interactions. A successful blueprint in one environment is not proof that every region is equivalent.

I am improving the wrong counter

A deeper Infinity in an already-counted region helps depth, but it does not turn nine regions into ten.

Ready to move on?

  • The required depth and ten-region coverage are recorded.
  • Current module objectives are complete.
After the promotion

MT14 combines broader Infinity coverage with the Infinity Stone requirements. Start building-specific tasks early so they do not become the final wait. [S02] [S05] [S07] [S09]
